## Motivation

Reviewers need an explicit existing-code baseline, the proposed revision, matching scientific inputs and settings, and a complete-process timing boundary. Separate proposed normal CPU, Torch CPU and Torch CUDA arms identify shared changes and backend costs.

## Contents

Controlled campaign, profile acquisition, summary, artifact-validation and offline plotting tools; CPU/GPU test selectors; usage, parity and comparison guides. Runtime implementations and their regressions live in the preceding owning PRs.

The comparison method fixes 384 distinct compressed templates, 1904 unique H1 seconds, input hashes and scientific geometry. It requires unchanged CPU plus proposed normal CPU, Torch CPU and Torch CUDA, clean pinned builds, matching one-core/thread CPU resources, an explicitly identified GPU, scientific qualification and at least three rotating fresh-process repeats timed through completed HDF output.

**The matched timing campaign is complete; scientific equivalence to unchanged PyCBC fails.** Unchanged baseline `40e94792b3edf59f39b18b65102b28a4f74433a7` and main proposal `123e1fb3ef1b338cada636e71c3e9c7987002402` were built independently with the same dependencies. Four rotating fresh-process repetitions per arm give these descriptive costs on shared host `len`; each arm uses one CPU core/thread and CUDA additionally uses RTX 4090 GPU 0.

| Arm | Median seconds | Observed range | Triggers |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Existing CPU | 67.833 | 66.377–76.056 | 1988 |
| Proposed CPU | 66.626 | 65.531–70.279 | 1991 |
| Proposed Torch CPU | 106.597 | 102.795–112.295 | 1991 |
| Proposed Torch CUDA | 20.926 | 20.351–26.063 | 1991 |

The initial controller stopped before timing. A disclosed post-qualification continuation collected descriptive costs after checking proposed trigger parity and exact strain, geometry and used PSD bins. The full failures and original stop are preserved, and the independent verifier rejects equivalent-output speedup eligibility. [Raw outputs, all samples, comparisons and reproduction](https://github.com/xangma/pycbc/tree/bc88a36a225f9b89559e0480e66fac828ee3dd77/baseline-final-20260908).
